Against the shipped deck: Q12(a)(ii) and Q16(b)(ii) each print one tariff across two headings and are now one task each (the second card resolves by alias); Q11(a)(ii), Q11(b)(ii) and Q15(a) take the marks printed for the objective answer as well as the explanation; menus are restored to the scheme’s full headed lists; six demonstrably wrong topics are corrected. Every stem and ask is sliced from the paper and every marking point from the scheme (econ_2021_hl.py; the Section A script is retired). Choose-N rule checked: Q14(c)(iii) "choose two" is one any-two card; no printed choose-N-of-M item pool.
